$comment: Registry of every environment variable the witness config loader accepts. apply-env-overrides.ts is the only consumer of process.env allowed to walk this file.

SWALL_ENV.notes: New in Phase 6, mirroring internal-soul. Never inferred from GITHUB_WORKSPACE, NODE_ENV, or anything else.

SWALL_API_BASE.notes: No default in any environment -- loadWitnessConfig() throws if unset, unchanged behavior (byte-identical to scripts/sign-sth.js).

WITNESS_KEY_ID.notes: Explicit override; unset falls back to deriveWitnessKeyId()'s did:web derivation from swallApiBase -- unchanged behavior.

GITHUB_WORKSPACE.notes: GitHub Actions-injected; unset falls back to process.cwd() -- unchanged behavior. Not operator-set directly outside CI.

$secretEnvVars: Arrives as a GitHub Actions Secret bound directly to the workflow's env: block (deployment topology, unchanged by this phase) -- resolved through the secret provider's env-binding mode, not through apply-env-overrides.ts.
